name: Men's Nose Hair Trimmer Stainless Steel Manual Trimmer Suitable For Nose Hair Razor Washable Portable Nose Hair Trimmer
description:
Name: Nose Hair Trimmer 
Material: Stainless steel 
Color: Silver 
Weight: 70g 
Length: Approx. 5cm/2 inch 
Stainless steel material, sharp precision design, easy trim, durable, and easy to use. 
Mechanical, can be operated by one-handed manual quickly and simply. 
No battery required, energy-saving, environmental protection, and safety. 
Compact and lightweight, easy to carry and use anywhere or anytime. 
Clean simply by Cleaning brush with water 
Package Included: 1 Piece Nose Hair Trimmer
